ValidationRule.description: Site Name should not be editable for DRD Profile and DRD Manager and All APS // HRP-7910
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISCHANGED(sked_Site_Building_Name__c), ISCHANGED(sked_Room_Name__c) ), OR( $Profile.Name = 'DRD Profile', $Profile.Name = 'DRD Manager', $Profile.Name = 'APS Admin', $Profile.Name = 'APS Management', $Profile.Name = 'APS Planner', $Profile.Name = 'APS Scheduler' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: DRD or APS User cannot edit Site/Building Name Or Room Name
